Gooey Brownies
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 3:19am

Ingredients




1 (21.5 oz) package brownie mix
1 (8 oz.) container sour cream
1 (12 oz.) package semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1 cup Chopped pecans

Preparation

1 Prepare brownie batter according to package directions; stir in sour cream, chocolate morsels, and pecans. Spoon into a greased 13 x9 inch pan. 2 Bake at 350 F for 30 to 35 minutes or until done; cool in pan on a wire rack. Cut into squares. 3 Yield: 2 dozen
